shared_scale_model: Within each independent trial/window a single range error is shared by all N rate samples. Windows and rate noises are independent. Draw the Gaussian sample-mean rate directly with sigma/sqrt(N).
correct_model: Exact v=d*q product moments with rate variance / N, unchanged shared range variance and zero rate-range covariance in this experiment
ablation: Same point estimates; full exact single-frame velocity covariance / N, incorrectly treating the shared range error as independent each frame; preserves x-y covariance

coverage.confidence_interval: Wilson binomial interval, 95%; applies only to independent synthetic trials

scope: Offline verification of a specific shared-scale error mechanism under declared noise assumptions. No LiDAR/camera state fusion, AP injection, real sensor accuracy, Orin runtime, integrity guarantee or real flight claim.
